item.title: Writing A HTTP Web Server In C
item.description: First Things First! For those who are here just for code and hack it to make it their own, please have it : #include <stdio.h> #include <stdlib.h> #include <string.h> #include <sys/types.h> #include <sys/socket.h> #include <netinet/in.h> #include <netdb.h> #include <arpa/inet.h> /** * Basic procedure to create server is. * setup hints in struct addrinfo * getaddrinfo() * use the information retrieved from getaddrinfo() to create a socket * call socket() * bind() socket to specific port * listen() to wait for incoming connection * accept() an incoming connection * send() your HTML file with an HTTP header.

item.title: Garbage Collection Systems And Myths
item.description: WARNING : THIS IS A DUMMY POST, PLEASE DON’T PAY ATTENTION! Basic Memory Manager /** * @brief MemoryManager state. * */ typedef struct memory_manager_t { HashTable* buffer_map; ///< Pointer to size map. . . . } MemoryManager; MemoryManager* MemoryManagerCreate(); void MemoryManagerDestroy(MemoryManager* m); . . . Writing memory managers are a difficult task. We have two basic options. First one is that we implement a full blown Garbage Collector that can scan the entire stack and heap for possible memory regions having no reference stored anywhere anymore, other is we implement a Memory Checker that’ll check if allocated memory objects are free’d or not.

item.title: RzIL Introductory Notes
item.description: References First Some idea about how RzIL works can be found here : https://github.com/rizinorg/rizin/blob/dev/doc/rzil.md RzIL is based on BAP’s Core Theory so do read about that too. Analysis code is present in librz/include/rz_analysis.h and librz/analysis. ESIL uplifters are present in librz/analysis/p and the new RzIL uplifters are present in librz/analysis/arch. Each of these intermediate languages can be emulated so there must be a VM to interpret these ILs and run them.
